name: breastcalculator
description: Breast Calculator — static site deployed to Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.build: node scripts/optimize.js && node scripts/cache-bust.js && echo 'Static site ready: minified, cache-busted, served as-is.' && exit 0
scripts.dev: echo 'Open index.html in a browser, or run: npx http-server -p 8000'
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy ./ --project-name=breastcalc --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy ./ --project-name=breastcalc --branch=preview
scripts.deploy:clean: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy ./ --project-name=breastcalc --commit-dirty=true --clean
